scope: All executable verifiers that interpret AWS read-API responses
rule: Every AWS read-response verifier must have regression coverage driven by an immutable response captured from the real AWS API. Hand-written client response dictionaries may not stand in for an AWS response fixture.
allowed_test_boundary: Pure policy evaluators may use domain-level values after the recorded-response parser boundary has been exercised by a real-response fixture.
fixture_requirements: Record the exact API operation and request selector.
Record capture time, AWS account, region and caller identity separately from the raw response.
Keep the raw response payload byte-stable and content-addressed.
Cover known optional-field and response-grouping behavior from the real payload.
Fail closed if a production response cannot be normalized into the tested domain shape.
prohibited: Inventing an AWS response shape in a unit-test fake
Requiring incidental list grouping, list order or optional-field presence that is not a policy invariant
Silently adapting a fixture after a verifier failure
